definitions.gloss: signing; sealing (a treaty, agreement, or contract)
definitions.explanation: The formal act of signing an official document such as a treaty, agreement, or contract to make it binding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{調印|ちょういん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{調印|ちょういん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The two countries signed a peace treaty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、ようやく⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調印式|ちょういんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: After long negotiations, the signing ceremony for the trade agreement was finally held.

notes:
{調印|ちょういん} is a formal term for the signing of official documents, particularly treaties and international agreements. It is more formal and ceremonial than ⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧ (signature).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{調印|ちょういん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (sign a treaty)
- {調印式|ちょういんしき} (signing ceremony)
- {調印|ちょういん}{国|こく} (signatory nation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調印|ちょういん} vs ⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧: {調印|ちょういん} refers specifically to the formal signing of treaties and official agreements, while ⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧ is a more general term for signing one's name on any document.
